0.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_NONOTTA_000_045
0.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, what excellent timing! I was handing out another pile of gifts to our helpers, and am in dire need of a tea break. Would you be so kind...?

1.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_SYSTEM_000_046
1.description: You can now replay the gift-giving task from the quest “A Poultry Sum.”

3.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_KANESENNA_000_020
3.description: Greetings. We have come to report the completion of our part in the decorations.

4.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_KANESENNA_000_021
4.description: 'Tis a joyful duty to assist with the Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide adornments, knowing that every inhabitant of Gridania might enjoy the festivities. I hope you, too, will take a moment to join in this rare chance for revelry.

5.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_KANESENNA_000_022
5.description: ...In charge of rewarding festival helpers, you say? I've not done aught so grand as to merit a reward, but in the spirit of the occasion I shall humbly accept your gift.

6.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_Q4_000_000
6.description: Which gift set will you choose from?

7.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_A4_000_001
7.description: The rabbit and chicken stuffed toys.

8.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_A4_000_002
8.description: The painted eggs filled with treats.

11.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_KANESENNA_000_024
11.description: If you'll take the rabbit, then I shall claim this adorable chicken.

12.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_BODYGUARD01623_000_025
12.description: A gift from y-you...? I shall treasure it always!

13.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_KANESENNA_000_026
13.description: My, what lovely colors... And judging by this scent, there are baked treats hiding within. A perfect accompaniment for my morning tea.

14.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_KANESENNA_000_027
14.description: Well, isn't this exquisite... It shall grace my mantle as a memento of these happy celebrations.

15.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_KANESENNA_000_028
15.description: Such a lovely surprise! Now, if you will pray excuse us...

16.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_MIOUNNE_000_030
16.description: Hah, why am I not surprised to see you here? We had a guild meeting scheduled, but you know how adventurers are─we just had to get involved in the celebrations.

17.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_MOMODI_000_031
17.description: And seein' how the Dreamers always do such a nice job of decoratin' Ul'dah, I figured this was the perfect chance for me to return the favor.

18.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_BADERON_000_032
18.description: Eh? Passin' out presents to us laborers, are ye? Far be it from me to refuse a gift given freely!

19.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_Q5_000_000
19.description: Which gift set will you choose from?

20.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_A5_000_001
20.description: The rabbit and chicken stuffed toys.

21.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_A5_000_002
21.description: The painted eggs filled with treats.

23.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_MOMODI_000_033
23.description: Oooh, those are just darlin', ain't they? Not exactly a match for the Quicksand's decor, though, so I might need to keep 'em in my room...

24.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_MIOUNNE_000_034
24.description: Ah, these are the type they fill with baked delights! There's nothing better than enjoying a sweet treat after a hard day's work.

25.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_BADERON_000_035
25.description: Don't go 'oardin' 'em all to yerself now. I've got time for a quick bite an' a cup o' Mother Miounne's best tea afore I make the trip back to Limsa Lominsa.

26.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_MOMODI_000_036
26.description: Sounds like a grand idea. Count me in!

27.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_BADERON_000_037
27.description: Now ain't that a delicate beauty! But where's a safe spot to put it? Wouldn't survive two days in the Wench, considerin' the unsteady state o' me regular clientele...

28.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_MIOUNNE_000_038
28.description: We'd best be off and leave you to your business, then. Do come visit us at the Canopy when duty permits!

29.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_KURENAI_000_040
29.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! You are also taking part in this curious festival? I confess I find it passing strange to be speaking with you thus beyond the boundaries of the Ruby Sea.

30.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_SANANA_000_041
30.description: When I said I was headed this way to scout market prices, I was informed─not asked, mind you─that Her Highness here would accompany me in “an effort to better understand the outside world.” Do me a favor and keep this from Shiosai, would you?

31.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_KURENAI_000_042
31.description: You say we are to be rewarded? I had thought our inclusion in the ritual painting of the chicken eggs was reward enough, and now you offer me gifts. I am overwhelmed by your generosity!

32.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_Q6_000_000
32.description: Which gift set will you choose from?

33.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_A6_000_001
33.description: The rabbit and chicken stuffed toys.

34.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_A6_000_002
34.description: The painted eggs filled with treats.

36.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_KURENAI_000_043
36.description: Oh, are these...little animal dolls? And so wonderfully soft to the touch!

37.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_SANANA_000_044
37.description: Oho, I know a treat-filled egg when I see one. It's interesting how the presentation makes the contents feel that much more special... In fact, I reckon I could sell these for a profit if you weren't just giving them away.

38.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_KURENAI_000_045
38.description: Such delicate and splendid artifice. And you call this an “Ar-kon” egg? Nay, 'tis far too precious a treasure for me to accept.

39.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_SANANA_000_046
39.description: I thought you came with me to experience the “outside”? It's customary to receive eggs on Hatching<hex:021F0103>tide, so please, just take the gift.

40.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_KURENAI_000_047
40.description: Yes, I suppose you are right. After all, this would be the perfect souvenir for Hisui!

41.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_KURENAI_000_048
41.description: <sigh> I shall make one last turn around town, then I suppose I should return home. I pray we meet again soon in Tamamizu!

42.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_FUFUCHA_000_050
42.description: I don't know if my sense for decoration is all that appealing, but I seem to have made a feathered friend. She must be from the flock belonging to Master Pawlin.

43.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_FUFUCHA_000_051
43.description: Watching the struggles from afar, I had come to the conclusion that chickens are troublesome creatures, yet this one seems docile enough. So far, she's been content to follow me around as I put the finishing touches on my adornments. Is it my costume, I wonder...?

44.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_FUFUCHA_000_052
44.description: A gift? For me? I feel somewhat guilty accepting a reward for an activity I so thoroughly enjoyed...but if you insist!

45.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_Q7_000_000
45.description: Which gift set will you choose from?

46.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_A7_000_001
46.description: The rabbit and chicken stuffed toys.

47.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_A7_000_002
47.description: The painted eggs filled with treats.

49.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_FUFUCHA_000_053
49.description: These toys are certainly soft and pleasant to hold, yet I cannot help but wonder what kind of plant fiber was used in their construction. Curse of the professional botanist, I'm afraid.

50.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_FUFUCHA_000_054
50.description: Are these the eggs they fill with treats? That would explain the delicious aroma. Just what I need after a hard day's work in the planting fields.

51.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_FUFUCHA_000_055
51.description: These Archon eggs are exquisite, aren't they? Speaking from the viewpoint of one who provides raw materials to artisans, I am thrilled to see my humble contributions transformed into such works of art.

53.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_FUFUCHA_000_057
53.description: You like it too, do you? Then I shall display it in a place of pride, where it shall serve as a memento of our brief and unusual companionship.

54.name: TEXT_FESEST2021RECOLLECTION_00714_FUFUCHA_000_058
54.description: Now, I think it's time I returned this wayward hen to her owner. Fare you well!
